contexts.null_key_seed: Existing delete-policy log receives null keys, then switches to compact config before actual Cleaner.doClean; this does not claim compact-topic Produce admission accepts null keys.
contexts.filter_only_cases: Caller supplies an explicit keep-offset predicate and RETAIN_EMPTY/DELETE_EMPTY; Apache filterTo performs actual serialization. These cases are not relabeled as genuine Cleaner policy execution.
contexts.malformed_cases: Checksum-valid mutations except the named CRC case; actual official parser/iteration outcomes retained. Any permissive Apache outcome remains separate from stricter local ordinary-read safety policy.
